name: Midsummer's Night
source:
Midsummer's Night is a NSFW furry visual novel set in Latvia, during the midsummer solstice.

Move back to your home in the small Eastern European country of Latvia, reconnect with your best friend, and get to know some of the locals. You will experience the traditions of the midsummer solstice with them, but an unforeseen phenomenon of an eternal night affects the region. How will you and your friends react, and how will it affect your relationships?

[From [url=https://vajratheunholy.itch.io/midsummers-night]Itch.io[/url]]

This project has been put into 'On hold' status.
